description: This file contains utility classes and functions for testing reporting components in the Chromium project, including mock implementations of uploaders, delegates, and context setup for testing reporting behavior.

classes.name: PendingUploadImpl
classes.description: Mock implementation of a pending upload for testing reporting uploads.

classes.name: TestReportingUploader
classes.description: Test class simulating reporting uploader behavior, managing pending uploads.

classes.name: TestReportingDelegate
classes.description: Test class simulating reporting delegate behavior, managing permissions and report queuing.

classes.name: TestReportingContext
classes.description: Test class setting up reporting context with mock timers and store for testing.

classes.name: ReportingTestBase
classes.description: Base class providing utilities for testing reporting components, including cache and endpoint management.

classes.name: TestReportingService
classes.description: Test class simulating reporting service, managing reports and cache observers.

methods.name: TestReportingRandIntCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback that returns pseudo-random integers within a range for testing.

methods.name: StartUpload
methods.description: Simulates starting an upload in the test uploader.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Handles shutdown procedures for the test uploader.

methods.name: GetPendingUploadCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns the count of pending uploads for testing.

methods.name: CanQueueReport
methods.description: Determines if a report can be queued based on origin.

methods.name: CanSendReports
methods.description: Checks if reports can be sent to a set of origins.

methods.name: PermissionsCheckPaused
methods.description: Checks if permissions check is paused.

methods.name: ResumePermissionsCheck
methods.description: Resumes paused permissions check.

methods.name: CanSetClient
methods.description: Checks if a client can be set for an origin and endpoint.

methods.name: CanUseClient
methods.description: Checks if a client can be used for an origin and endpoint.

methods.name: CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a new reporting context with specified policy and time.

methods.name: UsePolicy
methods.description: Updates the context with a new reporting policy.

methods.name: UseStore
methods.description: Sets the store used by the context and recreates it.

methods.name: FindEndpointInCache
methods.description: Finds an endpoint in the cache for testing.

methods.name: SetEndpointInCache
methods.description: Sets an endpoint in the cache for testing.

methods.name: SetV1EndpointInCache
methods.description: Sets a V1 endpoint in the cache for testing.

methods.name: EndpointExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint exists in the cache.

methods.name: GetEndpointStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for an endpoint.

methods.name: EndpointGroupExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint group exists in the cache.

methods.name: ClientExistsInCacheForOrigin
methods.description: Checks if a client exists in cache for a given origin.

methods.name: MakeURL
methods.description: Generates a test URL based on an index.

methods.name: SimulateRestart
methods.description: Simulates a restart by advancing time.

methods.name: GetPolicy
methods.description: Returns the current reporting policy.
